final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS amount FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT state, amount, amount * 1.0 / total AS share FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT state, amount, share, share - average_share AS excess FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share) SELECT SUM(amount), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM step5
